title: Voiced hiragana: D and B rows — find the sign
description: Choose the written hiragana from visible spellings; same-sound signs use explicit base-sign context.

review.provenance: Independently authored F05 voiced and semi-voiced sign exercises, not copied from legacy CSV or mocks.
review.rightsBasis: Original agent-written English prompts, feedback and glosses; kana correspondences are linguistic facts. No third-party work, recording or audio used.

exercises.prompt: Which hiragana sign matches the conventional da cue?

text.gloss: Hiragana sign for the da reading.
Hiragana ぢ: the voiced spelling of ち, conventionally cued as di; spelling is not inferred from sound alone.
Hiragana づ: the voiced spelling of つ, conventionally cued as du; spelling is not inferred from sound alone.

exercises.explanation: The written target is だ. Hiragana sign for the da reading. Similar-sounding signs are not interchangeable spellings.
